Class RecentProjectsStore

java.lang.Object
ua.stetsenkoinna.recentprojects.RecentProjectsStore
public class RecentProjectsStore extends Object
The "recent projects" registry: ~/.PetriObjModelPaint/data/recent-projects.properties, next to the other per-user data the app keeps outside its config file.

Entries are keyed by id, upserted by absolute path - opening or saving the same file again updates that one entry in place rather than adding a duplicate. The list is capped at MAX_ENTRIES; once exceeded, the least-recently-opened entries are dropped first.

Every failure to read or write is logged and swallowed, the same philosophy as AppSettings: a corrupt or unwritable registry is not a reason to refuse to open the editor. An unreadable file means an empty list, an unwritable one means this session's changes do not outlive it.

  • Constructor Details

    • RecentProjectsStore

      public RecentProjectsStore(Path file)
      Parameters:
      file - the properties file to read now and write back on every change; it does not have to exist, and its directory is created on the first save. Null for a registry that lives for this session only.

      public RecentProjectEntry recordOpened(Path file, String name)
      Records that file was opened: upserts by absolute path (reusing the id and createdAt of any existing entry for that path), bumps lastOpenedAt to now, updates the display name, and persists immediately. Evicts the oldest entries if this pushes the registry over MAX_ENTRIES.

    • recordSaved

      public RecentProjectEntry recordSaved(Path file, String name)
      Records that file was saved: same upsert as recordOpened(java.nio.file.Path, java.lang.String), but bumps both lastEditedAt and lastOpenedAt to now - a save implies the document is open.
